title: Saudi-Backed Forces ROUTED in Yemen as Oil Surges and War Spirals
author: Ryan Grim
content:
Twenty-five years after 9/11, the United States is again fighting a major war
in the Middle East. Drop Site's Ryan Grim and Murtaza Hussain speak with Vali
Nasr, professor of international affairs and Middle East studies at Johns
Hopkins SAIS and a former senior adviser in the Obama administration, and Rob
Malley, a senior fellow at Yale's Jackson School of Global Affairs, former
U.S. special envoy for Iran, longtime Middle East peace negotiator, and head
of the Middle East program at the International Crisis Group.

The conversation covers Ansarallah's advance in Yemen, the battle over the
Strait of Hormuz, Iran and the US duel strategies of economic pressure, the
future of U.S. military bases in the Gulf, the collapse of the JCPOA, Iran's
nuclear calculations, and whether Washington has learned the lessons of Iraq,
Afghanistan and the broader post-9/11 wars.
